IGUI_AutoPilot_E_Info: A macro does game actions, one at a time, as you would do them by hand. It is written in English, like Python. <LINE> Record: do the recipes by hand, then Finish: the macro writes itself. <LINE> Actions: craft("recipe", using="item", times=3), dismantle("item"), exercise("pushups", minutes=10), rest(), eat(open_cans=True), drink(), smoke(), wait(5), stop_if(...), stop(). <LINE> Blocks: repeat 10:, while possible:, while skill("Maintenance") < 4:, while True:, if ...: / elif ...: / else:. The block is the lines under it, indented by 4 spaces: no end. <LINE> when hungry >= 2: eat() - the when blocks are checked only in the pauses, never during an action, and hold for the whole macro. <LINE> Conditions: has("item", at_least=20), count("item") >= 3, skill("Maintenance") < 4, hungry, thirsty, stressed, tired, endurance < 30... (Insert > Condition), with and, or, not. <LINE> It stops like every job: move, zombies, severe thirst... and always says why. Favourite items are never used. <LINE> While you type, a list under the cursor shows what can be written there: arrows to choose, Enter or Tab to insert, Esc to close, Ctrl+Space to open it (option "Macro editor: typing suggestions"). <LINE> With a controller: record and run; writing needs the keyboard. Limits: the admin sets them.

IGUI_AutoPilot_MA_Ex5_Text: # Push-ups up to Strength 5 (push-ups train Strength, squats and sit-ups Fitness). <LINE> # In the pauses, never during an exercise: eat, drink, smoke, rest on the nearest chair. <LINE> when hungry >= 2: <LINE>     eat(open_cans=True) <LINE> when thirsty >= 2: <LINE>     drink() <LINE> when stressed >= 2: <LINE>     smoke() <LINE> when endurance < 30: <LINE>     rest(seat="nearest") <LINE> while skill("Strength") < 5: <LINE>     exercise("pushups", minutes=10)
